layout: one shaded (fat) jar, packages relocated (shaded.*), copied alone into a distroless static base; no JRE
scope: Java libraries inside /app/app.jar only. Base-image packages are OUT OF SCOPE for this key; they are counted separately.
severity_reference: NVD primary CVSS base severity (nvd@nist.gov); if no NVD primary, the secondary CNA score, source recorded; scanner-native severities are not stored here
upstream_advisories_source: OSV queries (Maven ecosystem), 2026-11-14: commons-text 1.9 (1 advisory), snakeyaml 1.30 (7), commons-lang3 3.11 (1), slf4j-api 2.0.9 (0, control)
independence_note: The key comes from OSV/GitHub advisory data and NVD, not from scanner output. OSV/GHSA data is also upstream of both scanners' databases, so agreement with it is not fully independent evidence.

status_meanings.AFFECTED: scanner SHOULD report it (counts toward recall)
status_meanings.FIXED_BY_BACKPORT: scanner should NOT report it (reporting = false positive)

predictions.status: HYPOTHESES recorded before building or scanning; not part of the answer key.
predictions.detection: Both tools report most or all of the 9 entries (recall 7 to 9 of 9 each). Moderate confidence: the shade plugin keeps each library's pom.properties inside the jar even after relocation, which is what scanners read. Most likely place for a miss: the transitive commons-lang3 entry (CVE-2025-48924), the newest advisory, whose library also sits inside the shaded jar.
predictions.severity: Both tools use GitHub severities for Maven, so both label CVE-2022-1471 HIGH while the reference is CRITICAL (a label difference, not a miss). Other labels match the reference. Moderate confidence.
predictions.false_positives: Neither tool reports anything on slf4j-api.
predictions.P1: BLOCK for both (commons-text CVE-2022-42889 is Critical).
predictions.note: Trivy's base-image advisory IDs (UNKNOWN) cannot change any BLOCK, since BLOCK wins over REVIEW.
predictions.how_scored: Package-level findings are scored against the entries above; base-image findings are listed separately.
